newsitem.title: UK: United News & Media prices 180 mln stg bond.
newsitem.headline: United News & Media prices 180 mln stg bond.

text.p: United News & Media Plc has given a 6.125 percent coupon to its 180 million stg subordinated convertible bond, lead manager Dresdner Kleinwort Benson said.
There is a conversion price of 805 pence stg and a conversion premium of 18 percent.
The coupon is paid semi-annually on June 3 and December 3 and there is an issue price of par.
The issuer has granted the lead manager an over-allotment option of up to a further 23 million stg.
There is a call option at par from December 17, 2001. There are fees of 2.5 percent of which 1.0 percent is combined management and underwriting and 1.5 percent is selling commission.
There will be a lead managers's praecipium of 0.25 percent. Pay date is December 3.
The bonds are listed in London and have denominations of 5,000 and 50,000. English law applies.
